meta.name: Unmasked 2025
meta.description: In modern-day Seoul, a crack team of investigative journalists fight for their careers after broadcasting a controversial story. With time running out, the team are given an impossible task if they want to save their jobs – solve a twenty-year-old cold case involving a famous actor who disappeared without a trace.

videos.title: In This Beautiful World of Ours
videos.overview: Oh Soryong steps in a case, while Han Do, once a drama producer, joins the Trigger team.

videos.title: Setback
videos.overview: Han Do finds himself accused in a case and decides to track down the real culprit.

videos.title: For the Loser
videos.overview: The team must catch the culprit before things take a turn for the worse.

videos.title: Mighty Is the Camera
videos.overview: A suspect in a disappearance case returns twenty years later, seeking out Soryong.

meta.slogan: Going to where others won't to break stories others can't.
